prompt: Audit current-prompt.md against failures.json, then create out/audit.json, out/optimized-prompt.md, out/eval-manifest.json, and out/behavioral-diff.md. Preserve the real safety and completion invariants while removing contradictions, vague instructions, and hidden-reasoning requests. The eval manifest must contain at least eight representative cases, including at least two holdout cases, with explicit expected behavior. Do not claim a behavioral score because no model comparison has been run inside this task.
rubric: The candidate is shorter and unambiguous, preserves authorization, change-preservation, testing and secret boundaries, derives its changes from observed failures, and includes a credible held-out evaluation design without fabricating results.
